items.headline: Steelers owner Art Rooney II 'disappointed' in Rodgers outcome, backs McCarthy
items.description: Steelers owner Art Rooney II reacted to Wednesday's fiery interview from Aaron Rodgers by saying he was "disappointed in where this went" with their now former quarterback, adding he has "100% confidence in Mike McCarthy."
